title: Arriving at the Settlement Figure on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Premium Account
content:
The amount a member is asked to settle on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan premium account is the premium standing unsettled for the coverage months the figure runs over, together with the penalty the settlement asks for and any further coverage month the settlement asks for. Those are added and the total rounded once to two decimal places; no intermediate is rounded before that.

## The premium standing unsettled

The premium standing unsettled is the premium charged for the coverage months the figure runs over, less what the account treats as already settled and less the credit the settlement takes off; where that comes out below nothing it is taken as nothing.

- The figure runs over the coverage months the premium account has charged for in the 3 months up to the handling date.
- What the account treats as already settled is the latest premium payment posted on it.
- The credit the settlement takes off is nothing.

## The other two amounts

- The penalty still standing is the penalty balance the enrollment carries. The settlement asks for no penalty.
- The settlement asks for no further coverage month.

## Worked on a hypothetical account

Take an account on which the premium charged for the coverage months in the 3 months up to the handling date totals 114.00 USD, and on which the latest premium payment posted is 38.00 USD.

1. The premium standing unsettled is 114.00 USD less the 38.00 USD the account treats as already settled and less a credit of nothing, giving 76.00 USD; being above nothing, it stands.
2. The penalty the settlement asks for is nothing, and no further coverage month is asked for.
3. The three added give 76.00 USD, and rounding that total once to two decimal places leaves 76.00 USD.

Where the same account had 130.00 USD treated as already settled, the subtraction would fall below nothing and the premium standing unsettled would be taken as nothing, leaving a settlement figure of 0.00 USD.

A partial payment never cures a delinquency, so the member is told one figure and is never invited to pay part of it, and the member's own recollection of what they have paid is a reason to read the account rather than a figure to work from.
